skill.name: Evidence-Based Verification Skill
skill.description: Guides AI agents to collect test, build, lint, and deployment evidence before marking work complete.
skill.summary: Evidence-first verification templates for AI-assisted software work.
skill.author: ArieGoldkin

security_audit.summary: Manual review found the static path traversal, shell execution, and reconnaissance alerts are false positives from Markdown examples, compiler output, and evidence snippets. No prompt-injection or malicious exfiltration text was found. The skill still needs guardrails for deployment commands and redaction of captured evidence output.

remediation.issue: Deployment commands can run without explicit approval.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation and an approved environment before deployment. Prefer dry-run or read-only checks as the default workflow.

remediation.issue: Evidence capture may store sensitive output.
remediation.suggestion: Add redaction rules for secrets, tokens, user data, internal hostnames, and credentials before evidence is stored or shared.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md lacks valid frontmatter for automated metadata scanning.
remediation.suggestion: Add valid YAML frontmatter with name, description, version, and supported tools so scanners can parse the skill reliably.

content.value_statement: Many teams mark AI-generated work complete without proof. This skill guides agents to collect test, build, lint, and deployment evidence before closure.
actual_capabilities: Defines workflows for implementation, code review, and deployment verification.
Provides templates for test, build, and code quality evidence.
Records exit codes, durations, coverage, warnings, and timestamps.
Shows successful and failed verification examples for common development tasks.
Lists common verification commands for JavaScript, Python, Rust, and Go.
limitations: It does not execute verification commands by itself.
It depends on project test, build, lint, and deployment tools.
It cannot prove correctness when tests or checks are incomplete.
Production deployment still requires human approval and project policy.

use_cases.title: Verify a Code Change
use_cases.description: Run the relevant checks, capture exit codes, and document whether the task is ready for review.

use_cases.title: Review Agent Output
use_cases.description: Confirm that another agent supplied real test, build, and quality evidence before accepting its work.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Release Gate
use_cases.description: Collect deployment readiness evidence, including build status, health checks, and rollback notes.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Verification
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after a small code change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify this change with the most relevant checks. Report exit codes, pass or fail status, timestamp, and any remaining issues.

prompt_templates.title: Review Evidence
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before accepting another agent output.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the submitted work and verify the evidence. Identify missing tests, failed checks, weak claims, and the next required action.

prompt_templates.title: Quality Gate Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before a pull request or task handoff.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a task completion evidence report with tests, build, lint, types, coverage, output summary, and a final readiness decision.

prompt_templates.title: Release Readiness Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before staging or production deployment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess release readiness using evidence from tests, build, security checks, health checks, rollback plan, and deployment approval status.

output_examples.input: Verify a login feature before code review.
output_examples.output: Tests passed with 24 passing and 0 failing. Build passed. Lint passed with one warning. Evidence includes timestamp and review status.

output_examples.input: Check a failed profile update task.
output_examples.output: Verification failed. Three tests failed around email validation. The task is not complete until validation fixes pass new evidence checks.
Pre-deployment checks passed, health check responded successfully, and rollback procedure was documented. Deployment still requires explicit approval.

best_practices: Run verification after the final change, not before it.
Capture exit codes, timestamps, and short output summaries for every check.
Treat failed evidence as a blocker until the issue is fixed and rechecked.
anti_patterns: Claiming tests passed without running or documenting them.
Ignoring failed builds because the implementation looks correct.
Using stale evidence from before the latest change.

faq.question: Does this skill run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It gives agents a verification workflow and templates for documenting checks they run.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code in the marketplace metadata.

faq.question: What evidence should be captured?
faq.answer: Capture exit codes, pass or fail counts, coverage when available, output summaries, timestamps, and the final readiness decision.

faq.question: Can it replace human code review?
faq.answer: No. It improves the evidence available to reviewers, but humans still decide acceptance and release policy.

faq.question: How should failed checks be handled?
faq.answer: Document the failure, keep the task incomplete, fix the issue, and run the relevant checks again.

faq.question: Should command output be stored exactly as printed?
faq.answer: No. Redact secrets, personal data, credentials, and internal infrastructure details before sharing evidence.
